usageNotes: Use this to verify a node's system clock and configured timezone — useful before scheduling time-sensitive operations or diagnosing certificate/authentication failures caused by clock skew. Requires Sys.Audit on /nodes/{node}; the node must be online and reachable by the API. Returns both UTC epoch (time) and local-time epoch (localtime), so compare them to confirm the timezone offset is correct.

examples.summary: Read the current time and timezone from node pve1

tips: The 'time' field is UTC epoch and 'localtime' is the same instant expressed in the node's configured timezone — subtract them to derive the UTC offset in seconds.

Clock drift beyond a few seconds will cause TLS certificate validation errors and Proxmox cluster quorum issues; if time looks wrong, check NTP status with post_nodes_node_time or inspect chrony/timesyncd on the node directly.
This endpoint is read-only and safe to poll frequently for monitoring purposes.
